lines.zh: 我贴着河底游，尾巴慢慢摆。
lines.en: I swim along the riverbed, tail moving slowly.

lines.zh: 我的身子又长又硬，转得慢。
lines.en: My body is long and stiff; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我摆一下尾，滑出去半盏茶的路。
lines.en: One tail beat carries me a way downriver.
I drift with the current toward the bank.
I slide past the water weeds.
I tilt and steady myself.
I swim with my mouth open.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片很硬，水从上面滑过。
lines.en: Water slides over my hard scales.

lines.zh: 我沿着红杉林下的水面走。
lines.en: I follow the water under the redwoods.

lines.zh: 我绕过沉在水里的树枝。
lines.en: I round a sunken branch.
I pause in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转身，朝深水去。
lines.en: I turn slowly for the deep water.
I swim in the shade along the bank.

lines.zh: 我一动，水底的泥就扬起来。
lines.en: My movement stirs the silt.
I am long, but very light.
My mouth is slightly open.

lines.zh: 我在等有小东西游过来。
lines.en: I am waiting for something small to swim by.
I look like a sunken log.
There are markings on my back.
I spend almost no effort.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转了一下眼睛。
lines.en: My eye turns slowly.

lines.zh: 水底的石头我看了很久。
lines.en: I have stared at the bottom stones a long while.
There is little to do here.
I do not need to go ashore.
I ease closer to the weeds.

lines.zh: 我从水下看着岸上的你。
lines.en: I watch you on the bank from underwater.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进了我这条水里。
lines.en: You have put your hand into my water.
My mouth points at your fingers.
I ease back a little.
You are much bigger than my food.
I hang there without moving.

lines.zh: 水面把我的影子拉歪了。
lines.en: The surface distorts my shadow.

lines.zh: 我在水底盯着你看了好一阵。
lines.en: I watched you from the bottom for a good while.
When you move, the water breaks.

lines.zh: 我不是能抓得住的东西。
lines.en: I am not something you can catch.
One tail beat took me into the deep.
I rolled over on the bottom.
I churn the bottom muddy.
I sink back to the bottom.
I hold my mouth open and go still.
I swim a little crooked.
My blood is in the water.

lines.zh: 我的长嘴一伸，就能叼住小鱼。
lines.en: My long snout snaps up small fish.
Is that a bug or a small fish?
I swim toward it.
I can swallow that in one go.
I open my mouth and wait for it to come.
So small I can barely see it.
That taste spreads through the water.

lines.zh: 我一点点蹭到那味道旁边。
lines.en: I inch my way toward that smell.
One snap and the water shakes.
That is not much to eat.
Drop a little more.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，尾巴一摆我就滑开了。
lines.en: You touched me and one tail beat slid me clear.
I am slippery and hard.

lines.zh: 我在水里被推得转了个身。
lines.en: The shove turns me around in the water.
That kind of knock cannot hurt my scales.
I slip away from your hand.
My scales click where touched.
I swim back to where I was.
Water splashed across my back.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞我不放在心上。
lines.en: I pay that knock no mind.
That was you touching first.
The water warms, and this is what follows.
I hang beside it.
We hardly move.
It is quiet among the weeds.
We beat our tails at the same time.
This much water is enough.
I circle it slowly.
Afterwards we go our own ways.
What happens in water, water knows.
In the water, we stay very close.
Not food; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 它在水里漂着，我推了一下。
lines.en: I nudge it as it floats.
I bite; too hard.
I open my mouth and close it.
I do not even have hands.
That will come apart in water.
I pay this no heed.

lines.zh: 水面漂来的东西，我一口咬住。
lines.en: Whatever drifts by, I snap it up in one bite.
I hung utterly still.

lines.zh: 我听见水里有一点动静。
lines.en: I hear a small stir in the water.
I turn my head that way.

lines.zh: 我的长嘴已经对准那道影子。
lines.en: My long snout is already fixed on that shadow.
My jaws are hanging wide.
It is closer than I thought.
The silt blocks my view.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草，慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: I hug the weeds and drift closer.
This bite has to be exact.
My tail is ready.
I come in from the side.
I follow it, swimming slowly.
My jaws hang open, waiting for it to come in.
I follow along the bottom.
I am not fast, but my line is straight.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖在它上面了。
lines.en: My shadow has fallen over it.
One inch more and I reach it.
It is starting to panic.

lines.zh: 我不用看，水告诉我它在哪。
lines.en: I need not look; the water tells me where it is.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一下一下推着我。
lines.en: My tail pushes me on, beat by beat.
My jaws close on it.
That bite closed on nothing.

lines.zh: 我一口钳住，别想再滑走。
lines.en: I clamped down; you will not slip away again.
My teeth are stuck.
I open and shut quickly.
One wrench and it pulled free.
That bite was not clean.
A flick of my long snout, and the teeth arrive first.

lines.zh: 水底多了一个细长的影子。
lines.en: A long thin shadow appears on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我从深水里浮上来一点。
lines.en: I rise a little from the deep.
A ring spreads on the surface.
I hover in the river bend.
The bank here is steep.
Tree shade falls on the water.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾，定住位置。
lines.en: One tail beat sets my place.
The water comes from under the redwood roots.
I stop in the shallows.
I smell blood in the water.
You can hardly tell I am moving.
I wait for the surface to settle.

lines.zh: 我在水草间盘着，等人靠近。
lines.en: I coil among the weeds, waiting for someone to come near.

lines.zh: 水底的石头缝里，我探出头。
lines.en: I put my head out of a crevice in the bottom stones.
The water scalds and I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我摔在岸上，拼命拍尾巴。
lines.en: I land on the bank, tail thrashing.

lines.zh: 水太多也会呛人，我张大了嘴。
lines.en: Even water can drown; my mouth gapes.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从水里掀出去。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the water.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我的侧腹。
lines.en: Something pierces my flank.

lines.zh: 一股力顺着水流缠住我，我动不了。
lines.en: Some force came along the current and bound me still.

lines.zh: 没有水也没有底，我无处置身。
lines.en: No water, no bottom; I have nowhere to be.
